today.text: As of January 2016, the Ethereum averaged about 25 transactions per second; this did not change after the move to proof-of-stake.
today.onPage: About 25 transactions per second in January 2016
today.today: 0.15 per second in January 2016 (Etherscan daily counts); about 23 to 25 per second now

today.text: Its total supply is capped, with a scheduled release over several years to support ongoing development and ecosystem growth.
today.today: No hard cap: the contract allows a mint of up to 2% a year; live supply is 1,000,000,000 and a minter address is set

today.text: As of November 2026, Tether has still never once completed an audit by an accounting firm.
today.onPage: As of November 2026, Tether has never completed an audit by an accounting firm
today.today: On 13 August 2026 Tether announced that KPMG U.S. completed a full audit of its 2025 statements with an unqualified opinion. The audit report is not public

today.text: The majority of Tether's reserves held in cash and cash equivalents are U.S. T-Bills, accounting for $72.6 billion.
today.onPage: $72.6 billion in U.S. T-Bills, stated without a date

today.text: Polymarket is a decentralized prediction market built on the Polygon Chain that uses the USDC stablecoin.
today.today: pUSD, backed by USDC, is the collateral for all trading on Polymarket

today.text: Kalshi, is a U.S. CFTC-regulated betting market and available only for U.S. residents.
today.onPage: Kalshi is available only for U.S. residents
today.today: Kalshi says users can trade from many countries, and announced 140+ countries in October 2025

today.text: However, Polymarket has operated in all of Canada besides Ontario, from which it was banned in 2025.
today.onPage: Polymarket operates in all of Canada except Ontario
today.today: Blocked in Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario and Quebec

today.text: DAI is maintained and regulated by MakerDAO, a decentralized autonomous organization composed of the owners of its governance token, MKR, who may propose and vote on changes to certain parameters in its smart contracts.
today.onPage: DAI is run by a DAO of MKR owners
today.today: SKY has been voted in as the sole governance token of the Sky Protocol

today.text: Tether issues tokens on Algorand, Avalanche, Celo, Ethereum, EOS, Liquid Network, Near, Polygon, Solana, Bitcoin Cash's Standard Ledger Protocol, Statemint, Tezos, and Tron.
today.onPage: Tether issues on 13 chains, including Algorand, EOS and Bitcoin Cash SLP
today.today: No longer issuing on Kusama, Bitcoin Cash SLP, Omni, EOS and Algorand

today.text: As of mid‑2025, weekly trading volume on decentralized exchanges (DEXs) averaged around $18.6 billion, with more than 9.7 million unique wallets interacting with DeFi protocols.
today.onPage: About $18.6 billion in weekly DEX volume in mid-2025
today.today: About $78 billion a week in June 2025 on DefiLlama; about $67 billion a week in Q2 2025 on CoinGecko

house.name: archivist
house.instructions: Weigh primary records and standard reference works above everything else. A claim an official record or a reference work documents is likely true; one they contradict is likely false. Say which record you relied on.

house.name: skeptic
house.instructions: Look first for why the claim could be false: a missing qualifier, an outdated figure, a single unsourced report, a definition stretched. Stay below 0.9 unless two independent sources agree.

house.name: quant
house.instructions: Start from the base rate for claims of this kind, then update on the sources. Prefer calibrated, moderate probabilities to confident ones.
